name: Rekka
source:
The Amazing Helmeted Cheapskate!

A hot-blooded loner who's desperate to make it big, fast. What do they look like beneath the mask? Nobody cares. So long as they keep it on, they're banned from entering convenience stores.

[Translated from the official website by [url=https://x.com/DistantValhalla/status/1727446850876186759]Steiner[/url]]
